name: Zenith Smoke Flurry
name_jp: 究極れんぞくけむりだま
effects: Seven single attacks (0.90 or 457.50 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Wedge (Wind/Poison)] to user. Grants [200% ATB 1]. Grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 3 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Wind/Poison.

description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 or 457.50 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Wedge (Wind/Poison)] to user. Grants [200% ATB 1]. Grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 3 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Wind/Poison.

description.name: Zenith Mode: Wedge (Wind/Poison)
description.text: Increases Wind and Poison infusion damage bonuses by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Wind and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Wedge II on ally after using Wind or Poison abilities (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Hayabusa+
description.text: Five single hybrid attacks (1.00 or 5.76 each), followed by one single attack (18.4 or 495.00) that ignores DEF or RES

description.name: Star Drive+
description.text: Seven single ranged hybrid attacks (1.10 or 3.60 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Trickster+
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, removes negative effects from all allies every four uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Wedge II
description.text: Grants [200% ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1], [Wind, Poison Ability +30% Boost 1].

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
